notes: Coverage: I compared every word, ending, accent, abbreviation, punctuation mark, heading underline, and every inline mathematical expression against BOTH supplied witnesses in the two half images. The page contains no display, diagram, independent drawing, margin note, author page number, date, salutation, closing or signature. This is a visual coverage statement, not a mathematical proof check.

Workflow: the whole image was viewed once for layout, then half_a once and half_b once, in that order. Ten tight crops were made only for places left open by those views and each was viewed once. No whole or half image was reopened for visual inspection. No OCR, image-to-text software, PDF text layer, outside source, other scan, or other reader folder was used. No delegation and no LaTeX compilation were performed.

Half-settled witness differences retain approximate whole-source boxes in the corresponding change observation objects. They were not recropped by this reader. The main reader can use those retained boxes for adjudication.

c01 resolved the apparent punctuation after les as the final s itself, not an extra comma. c10 confirmed the full-word single underline of Exemple. These agreed readings therefore are not listed as changes.

The example takes A to be a ring on X and identifies M,N respectively with K^0,K^1 of the additive field of projective A-modules with the written v.f. abbreviation. It then attributes a construction to Mme Sinh producing an épinglé Picard field and a canonical section of the middle term. The cancelled word after section is kept separately. These are statements of the page only; I did not verify their mathematical validity.

The NB states that what precedes has the evident functorialities in M,N,X. The Question asks whether the exact triangle and exact sequence are known to the compétences named in the parenthesis, then asks about higher variants. The final parenthesis tentatively proposes n-champs de Picard non néc. stricts as a route to obtaining them. No theorem or calculation was checked in this reader run.

The long curved stroke under the small parenthetical addition is an insertion connector, not a separate drawing. Its attachment is immediately after f. The lateral nub at that attachment may be an independent abbreviation stop, hence the in-place doubt.

The extra small upright near the first reference full stop is preserved above-right of that stop. Its apostrophe/raised-point/nontextual alternatives concern textual status and shape; no mathematical exponent meaning is assigned.

Hand identification is conservative: the main writing, corrections and addition are an unnamed dark-pen hand; the archive 11 is a separate lighter pencil layer. Personal authorship is not independently established by this packet.
